  heat and price as a description list, and the cooking time.

<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "../blocks/dish-showcase.types";

  export type CutCardsProps = {
    dishes: Dish[];
    labels: FoodLabels;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let { dishes, labels }: CutCardsProps = $props();
</script>

<Grid cols="1-4" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
  {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
    <Stack gap="4" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-testid="item">
      <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio="4/3" />
      <Text size="lg" weight="semibold">
        {d.name}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {d.summary}
      </Text>
      <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
        <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
            {labels.weight}
          </Inline>
          <Inline class="font-semibold">
            {d.weight}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
        <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
            {labels.heat}
          </Inline>
          <Inline class="font-semibold">
            {d.tag}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
        <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
            {labels.price}
          </Inline>
          <Inline class="font-semibold">
            {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
      <Badge variant="secondary" size="default" class="w-fit">
        <LucideIcon name="timer" size={16} />
        {tpl(labels.minutes, (d.minutes == null ? undefined : String(d.minutes)))}
      </Badge>
    </Stack>
  {/each}
</Grid>
